title: Letter architecture
technique: A single ray-marched shader draws an endless folded fractal lattice of steel blocks, with sign lettering embossed into its surfaces as real relief that catches light.
music: Bass and vocal pitch change the fold angles so each note reshapes the building, the bar line opens the gaps between blocks, and every kick sends a pulse of light travelling through the space. Snares make the red lettering flare, hi-hats knock lights out or flash random blocks, and the camera never stops moving.

takes.name: Nave
takes.description: A flight down an arched corridor under fluorescent tube lights in fluorescent green, with a steel band of whole readable sign words on both walls and occasional power cuts where only the red lettering glows.

takes.name: Block
takes.description: The view moves outside into daylight, where a finite chunk of the lattice stands like a dark monolith on an endless cream printed sheet under a beige sky.

takes.name: Shaft
takes.description: A plunge down a square shaft lined with huge extruded phrase letters and square ring lights, drawn in dithered 1-bit black and white that flips to its negative on the snare.
words: EACH DOT IS BLACK OR WHITE.
THE SNARE SWAPS BLACK AND WHITE.
NO GREY NO GREY NO GREY

takes.name: Macro
takes.description: An extreme close-up skims sideways over a sliced plate where ink-blue and red letters stand up off ivory tiles under a low raking sun.

takes.name: Rotunda
takes.description: The camera sits inside a sphere carved from a more strongly folded lattice, where a glowing amber orb at the centre throws radial shadows over a dome of words, amber on black.

takes.name: Cut
takes.description: A flat, poster-like view square onto a diagonal slice through the lattice, with the cut face painted red, phrases knocked out in white, and soft white clay showing through the holes.

takes.name: Strafe
takes.description: The corridor again but in red emergency lighting, travelling sideways along the wall like a train window while one phrase at a time passes and alternate tube lights strobe on the beat.

as_processor: Uses the picture in place of the lettering: its brightness becomes raised relief on the fractal building and its colour becomes the paint, shown as a strip of film frames along the corridor walls, a print on the floor, or a poster on the cut face, then lit and graded by the take.
